name: OGRESS
source:
The protagonist was kidnapped for his cross-species fertility.
Awaiting him was a 9-foot-tall giant woman. An ogress. Ready to mate.
To survive a mating with the man-eating behemoth, he'll need to give everything he's got.

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax-touch/work/=/product_id/RJ165021.html]DLsite English[/url]]
